featured_reviews.review_text: This is a small place with a variety of shakes and juices. It has open seating. It attracts a lot of university students and the people who run this place are very amiable and fun to talk to. You can indulge in banters. They also serve special thandai on Holi. featured_reviews.review_text:
The variety of juices you get at this price point is just amazing!!
Some of my favourites are
Strawberry 🍓
Thick Oreo 🍫
Mosambi
KitKat
Lime juice🍋
The price ranges from 20-70 which is really affordable and amazing for these variety of fruit and chocolate juices.

featured_reviews.name: Ivan D'souza
featured_reviews.review_text: If you care about your health this is the place for you. Fresh fruit juices at the most reasonable rates in Marine lines. They also have milkshakes for those with a sweet tooth. Would highly recommend their watermelon juice, seasonal fruit juices (mango, strawberry, sitaphal) and their famous Oreo milkshake.

featured_reviews.name: Alston Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is a hidden gem that most people dont know about. U.K Juice centre known to students of St.Xaviers College as its the regular hangout spot. They have a lot of variety in fresh juices freshly made right in front of you. Number of milkshakes to choose from. The top on being the oreo milkshake. This is the best oreo milkshake you'll find. It also comes in two other various the double oreo and triple oreo shake. Triple oreo is enough to put you in a food coma. You never thought you'll find avocado shake here but it does. You read it right they have avocado shake as well. Also butterscotch and cold coffee are other few that you should try. Whenever you are in churchgate do go to U.K Juice Centre

featured_reviews.name: Mehdiali Agharia
featured_reviews.review_text:
During our recent visit to Shaan Juice in Mumbai Central, we were thoroughly impressed by the quality and taste of their offerings. The ambiance of the outlet was simple yet welcoming, providing a perfect setting for a refreshing treat.

We decided to try two of their standout creations: the Sitafal Cream and the Coconut Cream, both served in traditional coconut shells. From the very first sip, it was evident that the juices were crafted with care. The Sitafal Cream was thick, naturally sweet, and bursting with authentic sitafal flavor—rich, creamy, and indulgent without being overly sugary. The Coconut Cream, equally delightful, had a velvety texture with a fresh, tropical taste that perfectly captured the essence of fresh coconut. Both drinks were beautifully presented, enhancing the overall experience and making them feel like a special treat rather than just a beverage.

What stood out most was the emphasis on natural flavors. Unlike many commercial outlets that rely on artificial taste or syrups, Shaan Juice’s offerings felt wholesome and fresh. Every sip was a perfect balance of creamy richness and fruity sweetness, making it evident that quality ingredients were used.

Whether you’re a local or just visiting Mumbai Central, Shaan Juice is a must-visit for anyone who enjoys authentic, thick, and flavorful fruit creams. We left fully satisfied and already planning our next visit!

featured_reviews.name: Olivia Gomes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Escaping the hustle and bustle of Crawford Market, we stepped into Badshah for a quick break and what a delightful one it was!
From the rich, flavourful Pav Bhaji to the perfectly chilled Cold Coffee, every bite and sip felt satisfying.
The Dahi Batata Puri was fresh and crunchy with just the right balance of sweet and tangy flavours, while the Mango Fresh Cream was a refreshing treat that truly celebrated the season. The Veg Burger was simple, fresh, and well prepared.
What stood out beyond the food was the prompt service, warm hospitality, and attention to presentation. The newly added upper-floor extension has enhanced the dining experience, offering a more spacious and comfortable setting while preserving the charm of this iconic establishment.
Some places survive the test of time for a reason. Badshah continues its legacy by serving quality food with consistency and care.
A delicious pause amidst the shopping madness, definitely worth a visit!

featured_reviews.name: Aarti Madhumal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Badshah Snacks & Cold Drinks is one of those iconic Mumbai places that brings back memories every time I visit. Located right in the heart of Crawford Market, I've been coming here since I was a kid, and it continues to be a favorite stop whenever I'm in the area.

Anyone who has shopped around Crawford Market knows how crowded and chaotic it can get. Amidst all the bargaining, walking, and navigating through the endless crowds, Badshah is the perfect place to take a break and refresh yourself.

The ground floor is a non-AC section primarily dedicated to drinks and desserts. They serve an incredible variety of fresh fruit juices, fruit creams, and their famous faloodas. One thing I particularly love is that they also sell their flavored crushes in bottles, so you can take them home and make your own drinks or faloodas whenever you like.

My personal favorite has always been their watermelon juice. It comes with a couple of fresh watermelon pieces and is unbelievably refreshing, especially after hours of shopping in the busy market. It's simple, nostalgic, and never disappoints.

The first floor offers air-conditioned seating and a larger menu that includes snacks and chaat items. Whether it's their legendary pav bhaji, bhelpuri, or other chaat specialties, everything is consistently delicious. The food has that classic Mumbai flavor that keeps people coming back year after year.

The place itself is definitely compact and almost always packed with customers, so don't expect a spacious dining experience. But honestly, that's part of its charm. The energy, the history, the crowds, and the fantastic food all come together to create an experience that feels uniquely Mumbai.

If you're visiting Crawford Market, a stop at Badshah is almost mandatory. It's the perfect place to recharge, enjoy some classic snacks and drinks, and soak in a piece of old Mumbai that has stood the test of time.

The Jain Veg Cheese Grill Sandwich 🥪 was tasty, well-filled, and nicely grilled, making it a satisfying snack. Overall, a good spot for fresh juices and quick bites.

featured_reviews.name: Asmant Nimbalkar
featured_reviews.review_text: They have good combination juices, named after Bollywood. The taste was good, but I think it was not worth the price. Service was good and fast.

featured_reviews.name: Aastha Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: Tried the Fresh Strawberry Cream at Patil Juice Center, and it was absolutely delightful! The strawberries tasted fresh and juicy, perfectly paired with the rich, creamy texture. It was refreshing, not overly sweet, and made for the perfect indulgent treat. The quality and freshness really stood out, making it easy to see why it's such a popular choice. Definitely a must-try for strawberry lovers.

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Swami
featured_reviews.review_text: There are two branches of this. One behind Regal Palace hotel and the other one is this. I usually go to the other one but that was closed the day I went to recently, so had to visit this place. This a 4* place but that is a 5* one. It's fulfilling and costs around 150 to 300 depending on your choice.

featured_reviews.name: Sarvesh Jaiswal
featured_reviews.review_text:
We tried the Mango Berry Juice, and it was absolutely wonderful. The quality felt top-notch—fresh, rich, and full of flavor. At ₹230, it did feel a bit overpriced for the quantity, but the taste and quality make up for it.

There’s no seating available, so the place can feel a bit congested with all the rush. However, they do serve drinks directly to your car, which makes it a great option if you’re on a drive.

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Deo
featured_reviews.review_text: Again i would say an overhyped juice destination the only thing i liked was fresh fruits were used to make shake and juice rest it is very sumptuous specially who keeps their monthly expenditure fixed.Not very much interesting but can give it a try

featured_reviews.name: Sumedh Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently ordered a plate of batata bhajiya  from this Juce centre, and to be very honest, it was one of the worst food experiences I've had in a long time.

🔴 Taste: The fritters were stale, oily, and had a very unpleasant aftertaste. It was clear the ingredients used were not fresh, and the oil may have been reused multiple times.

⚠️ Hygiene & Health: Just a few hours after eating, I started suffering from severe diarrhoea, which made it clear that the food was unhygienic or contaminated. This is a serious health concern, and no customer should have to go through this.

❌ Overall Experience:

Very poor quality food

Risk to health and safety

🙏 I strongly urge the restaurant management to take this feedback seriously and improve the food quality and hygiene standards.

I genuinely hope no other customer faces such a terrible and painful experience like I did.

⭐ Rating: 1/5

featured_reviews.name: Ameen Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I tried a few drinks here, but Bell Bottom is my favorite! 😍
Had a really nice experience overall.
